test_dict_to_vec_conversion: test the DictToVecConverter by converting a dictionary of PyTorch tensors to and from a flattened vector
create_dict_to_vec_converter: create a DictToVecConverter instance with an example dictionary of tensors to determine key order and shapes
convert_dict_to_flattened_vector: convert a dictionary of PyTorch tensors into a single flattened tensor using the to_vec method
convert_vector_to_dict: reconstruct a dictionary of tensors from a flattened tensor using the to_dict method with original shapes
test_tensor_elementwise_operations_on_fl: test that elementwise operations like exp on a flattened vector are equivalent to applying them per tensor in the original dictionary
